summary.text: Joe de la Cruz is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Heather Somers (R / Independent Party of Connecticut).
He previously served in the Connecticut House of Representatives, representing District 41 from 2017 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: De la Cruz was born in Groton, Connecticut, completed an apprenticeship with the Connecticut Sheet Metal Workers program, and later became a general manager.
In 2014 he began serving as a counselor for the town of Groton.
He first won the House District 41 seat in 2016 and was re-elected in 2018 and 2020, taking office in 2017.
In the 2021-2022 session he sat on the Housing, Aging, and Veterans' Affairs committees.
He did not run for re-election in 2022 and left office on January 4, 2023, and Aundré Bumgardner succeeded him.
Ballotpedia lists the Connecticut AFL-CIO among his 2026 endorsers.
